LanguageData.DZ_Harpies_UnarmedOnlyDesc: Adds Genes and More's "unarmed combat only" and "very strong unarmed" genes to every harpy xenotype, so harpies fight with their wings and talons instead of weapons.
LanguageData.DZ_Harpies_RestartRequired: Changing this requires restarting the game. Pawns that already exist keep their current genes.
LanguageData.DZ_Harpies_UnarmedNeedsGenesAndMore: The unarmed harpies option needs Big and Small - Genes and More.
